synth.notes:
Blocks (colour 10, 4x4) move by 4: A1/A2 up/down, A3/A4 apart/together (mirrored). Each block moves on its own if the destination 4x4 is all floor colour 5, so the maze is read from the frame.
Clicking an inactive marker (9) arms: blocks turn into colour-1 players and that marker becomes active (11). Clicking another marker switches; clicking a player disarms; clicking the active marker or a block does nothing.
While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker by 4. The destination cell (marker grown by 1) must be floor. A5 only advances the timer.
HUD: zeros in row 0 from the right and row 63 from the left, width 3(a+1)//7, where a = actions this level including no-ops.
Open: a is hidden. It is carried only while frames stay continuous; otherwise the guess is a=(7w+3)//3, or 0 with no bar (13/30 without memory). Walking into hazard colour 8 or a level win was never seen.
